prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable landscape editorial image for Chinese AI news articles
Primary request: create a brand-neutral visual metaphor for artificial intelligence infrastructure: a luminous processor core connected to layered data pathways inside a calm modern server environment
Scene/backdrop: abstract but believable technology space, no identifiable products
Subject: one central processor-like module, fiber-like data connections, subtle server silhouettes
Style/medium: premium editorial 3D illustration with restrained realism, crisp enough for article use
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape, strong central focus with generous negative space around the subject for flexible crops
Lighting/mood: thoughtful, credible, calm; soft cool highlights with warm neutral shadows
Color palette: charcoal, muted blue, warm off-white accents
Constraints: no logos, no brand colors, no people, no text, no watermark, no recognizable copyrighted product design; suitable as a generic fallback image for AI infrastructure, chips, models, or data-center stories
Avoid: neon cyberpunk excess, floating random letters, fake UI, clutter
